newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Mackie sets five-for-two rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Mackie sets five-for-two rights issue.

text.p: Mackie International Group Plc on Tuesday announced a five-for-two rights issue to raise a net 5.25 million sterling for completion of its foundry, restructuring costs and working capital.
Up to 30,362,500 new ordinary shares will be issued at a price of 20 pence per share, Mackie said in a statement.
Completion of the rights issue is an essential step to secure the future of the group, Mackie said.
If shareholders' approval for the rights issue is not obtained, new banking facilities will not be available to the group.
"The existing facilities are insufficient and the group will be left in a financial position where it will not be able to meet its commitments to creditors as they fall due," Mackie said.
NCB Stockbrokers is acting as broker to the rights issue which is being underwritten by the Bank of Butterfield through its agent, Butterfield Securities.

Mackie's new chief executive Sul Sahota, Roger Looker, a non-executive director, and related trusts of former director Pat Dougan have agreed to participate as sub-underwriters for new ordinary shares up to the value of 1.4 million sterling.

Certain institutions have irrevocably undertaken to take up their rights to a total of 11,991,704 ordinary shares. Non-executive director Looker and an institutional investor have undertaken not to take up their rights to 1,715,942 new shares, Mackie said.

Arrangements have been made with Butterfield Securities for these entitlements to be dealt with as part of the underwriting and it is expected that they will be placed with a new institutional investor, Mackie said.
